scripts.dev: echo 'Use theme-level npm run dev: cd web/themes/custom/myeventlane_theme (or myeventlane_vendor_theme) && npm run dev'
scripts.start: echo 'Use theme-level vite preview: cd web/themes/custom/myeventlane_theme && npm run start'
scripts.mel:build: cd web/themes/custom/myeventlane_theme && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../myeventlane_vendor_theme && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.mel:lint: cd web/themes/custom/myeventlane_theme && npm run check:hero && npm run lint:css
